use.flag: Install legacy Dotty aliases (dotr, dotc, dotd)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Scala 3 (Dotty) packaged from the official compiler tarball, matching AUR scala3/scala-dotty. The tree is installed under /usr/share/scala3 with versioned launchers scala3, scalac3, and scaladoc3 so Scala 2 from dev-lang/scala-bin can remain on PATH. USE=dotty adds the old dotr/dotc/dotd names. This is not a from-source build: the compiler bootstrap needs Coursier/sbt downloads that Portage cannot perform in the network sandbox. Scala 3.8 requires a JRE 17 or newer.
